description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface to filter log messages by passing only the message content, useful for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters logs to only show message content, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters incoming log messages to pass only the message to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the logging chain.
